concepts.gloss_en: 'Bereishit' — the opening word/complete utterance (מאמר השלם) of Torah, the aspect of 'before creation'; the heard/Nishma dimension
'Reishit' — beginning/first, identified with chochmah ('reishit chochmah'), the birthright (bechora), aspect of kodesh

notes: The clitic ב is not merely orthographic here: בראשית denotes the specific opening word/maamar of Torah and 'before creation' (LM1:22, LM2:12), whereas ראשית denotes 'beginning' equated with chochmah per 'reishit chochmah' and the bechora (LM1:1,15,80). Different referents — kept separate per rule 4 and under-merge preference.
